item.title: LOT-136: poll display and vote in the reader
item.body:
LOT-136
Closes #226
Claim: cloud/lot-136

**Problem.** The reader shows no poll: a member cannot see results nor vote (GAP-059).

**Cause.** `ReaderPage` carried no poll, and nothing in the app called LOT-054's `PollVoteFlow`.

**What changed.** `ReaderPage.poll` (from `PollParser`, nil when unreadable, never fails the page); `ReaderPollFlow` toolbar button + `PollSheet` (options, results, HFR notice/total); `PollModel` (choice, phases); `PollVoting` seam over the unchanged `PollVoteFlow` (`ComposerServices.pollVoter`). A confirmed, `unconfirmed` or `alreadyVoted` outcome reloads the topic; `unconfirmed`/`alreadyVoted` cannot be re-sent from the sheet. Single choice only (multi-choice pending capture #111). No engine change. Spec: `docs/lots/LOT-136-poll-display-and-vote.md`.

**Tests.** `PollModelTests` (all `PollVoteError` outcomes, one send, reload counts, no account, results/multi-choice) and two `LiveTopicPageSourceTests` (poll on R32b/R33a, none on R20). Not run locally: the app does not build on Linux; CI builds and tests it. SwiftLint clean locally.

## Mac check needed
For `mac/m2-lead`:
- [ ] Open a topic with a poll (R32b-like): "Sondage" button in the reader toolbar; sheet lists the answers.
- [ ] Vote with a real account on a test poll: HFR's sentence shown, topic reloads, sheet shows results; vote counted on the site.
- [ ] Second vote attempt: "déjà voté" message, results shown.
- [ ] Closed poll and already-voted poll: results and notice, no "Voter".
- [ ] Logged out: answers shown, "Connectez-vous pour voter.", no button.
- [ ] Offline vote: error, nothing sent, "Voter" still enabled.
- [ ] Light, dark, Dynamic Type XL, iPhone 18 Pro and iPad (iOS 27.0).
- [ ] Capture (#111): a multi-choice poll; the page HFR refreshes to after a vote from page ≠ 1.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CGZmsLcg6V8jS1M8Aw)_

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Polls appear on topic pages when available, including results-only polls. Answer options and results show vote counts and percentages.
  * Eligible single-choice polls can be voted on, with progress and outcome messages during and after submission.
  * Signed-out readers can view results but cannot vote; unsupported poll formats show a notice.
* **Improvements**
  * Topics refresh after confirmed, unconfirmed, or already-submitted votes to keep poll results current. Unconfirmed and already-submitted votes cannot be resubmitted from the same poll sheet; other vote errors leave the poll available for another attempt.

Walkthrough

The reader now parses supported topic polls and displays them in a poll sheet. The sheet shows results or single-choice voting controls. A session-bound voter submits votes, and the model handles vote outcomes and topic reloads. **Changes: Poll display and voting** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Poll data and voter wiring**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderPage.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicPageSource.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Polls/PollVoting.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyPosting.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/LiveTopicPageSourceTests.swift`|Reader pages now include polls parsed from topic pages, or `nil` when no poll exists or parsing fails. Composer services provide a session-bound voter when an account is present. Tests cover pages with and without polls.| |**Vote state and outcomes**
`App/SwiftHFR/Polls/PollModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Polls/PollMessages.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Polls/PollModelTests.swift`|`PollModel` tracks selection, eligibility, submission, and vote outcomes. Confirmed, unconfirmed, and already-voted outcomes reload the topic; other errors leave voting retryable. Messages vary by outcome and network error. Tests cover model behavior and reuse.| |**Reader poll sheet**
`App/SwiftHFR/Polls/PollSheet.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `docs/lots/LOT-136-poll-display-and-vote.md`|The reader adds a poll toolbar flow and sheet with voting controls or results. The topic model updates a held poll model after page reloads. The LOT document describes the flow, outcomes, and edge cases.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant ReaderPollFlow participant PollSheet participant PollModel participant LivePollVoter participant PollVoteFlow participant TopicReaderModel ReaderPollFlow->>PollSheet: Opens sheet with poll and voter PollSheet->>PollModel: Submits selected option PollModel->>LivePollVoter: Sends vote LivePollVoter->>PollVoteFlow: Forwards vote with session PollVoteFlow-->>LivePollVoter: Returns vote result PollModel->>TopicReaderModel: Requests page refresh for confirmed or settled outcomes TopicReaderModel-->>PollModel: Updates held model with loaded poll ``` **Possibly related issues** - [ezzz/HFRnow#452](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/452): The poll voter uses `PollVoteFlow`, whose write path is the subject of this issue. - [ezzz/HFRnow#395](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/395): The model handles confirmed and unconfirmed vote outcomes, which this issue defines. - [ezzz/HFRnow#111](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/111): The change supports single-choice polls and documents multi-choice handling as pending capture. - [ezzz/HFRnow#138](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/138): The change displays poll-vote refusal outcomes, which this issue concerns. - [ezzz/HFRnow#112](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/112): The model handles `alreadyVoted` and prevents another submission from that sheet. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#294](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/294): This PR adds the `ComposerServices` and reader reply-flow contracts used by the poll wiring. - [ezzz/HFRnow#412](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/412): This PR adds the `PollVoteFlow` API and typed vote outcomes used by the voter and model. - [ezzz/HFRnow#257](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/257): This PR adds the reader types and models extended here for poll parsing and display. **Suggested labels:** `type: lot`
Merge Risk: Low · up to c5f7d

The poll feature has bounded display and voting edge cases; merge risk is low with follow-up ownership for these fixes.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to c5f7d

The new voting feature uses the existing authenticated submission flow and prevents repeat submissions while a vote is pending or may already have counted. No introduced security defect was established. Live voting and interruption behavior remain unverified. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The added authority is an explicit poll vote using the captured account session. The inspected adapter does not provide arbitrary destinations, credentials, or privileged operations. Its effective write scope is the poll identified by the validated form fields, subject to the forum's authorization and duplicate-vote handling. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Logged-out service composition supplies no voter. Account selection changes the environment's captured session rather than passing an account name as submission authority. Re-authentication into an existing session requires its expected account identity; login with another account uses a fresh session. - _observed_ — The pre-existing engine documents that cookies attach after its identity-and-token fence. The new caller retains that transport limitation. Existing-account login checks provide counterevidence to cross-account substitution through the app, but the exact server outcome during concurrent same-account re-login is not established. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — Pre-send cancellation and refused or unsent outcomes remain distinct from failures after request handoff. The latter become unconfirmed and lock the held model against resubmission, even if the subsequent reload fails or returns no readable poll. This preserves uncertainty rather than treating it as permission to retry.
